crossRefs.note: They didn’t know that Joseph understood them; for there was an interpreter between them.
See my hands and my feet, that it is truly me. Touch me and see, for a spirit doesn’t have flesh and bones, as you see…
Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t…
They didn’t know that Joseph understood them; for there was an interpreter between them.

people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

translations.web: Behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaks to you.
translations.bsb: Behold! You and my brother Benjamin can see that I, Joseph, am the one speaking with you.
translations.kjv: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaketh
translations.asv: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaketh unto you.
